name: doc
description: Interpret OCR'd documents (invoices/forms) into structured fields, or propose an extraction template. The document text usually comes from the chat's attached OCR context.

tools.name: interpret_document
tools.description: Parse OCR'd document text into structured JSON: kvs (header key-values), items (detail tables), totals (sums), notes (remarks/explanations). Call when the user asks to 解读/整理/提取 a parsed document, or wants its fields written to a sheet. Language- and layout-agnostic.

ocrText.description: OCR 识别出的文档全文（来自对话中的文档上下文）

tools.name: propose_recipe
tools.description: Generate an extraction-template candidate from OCR'd document text (fields: name/type/source/group + notes). Annotation labels (any language) are preferred as field names. Call when the user asks to 生成模板/建模板 for a document.

ocrText.description: OCR 识别出的文档全文
